verdict.rationale: Connecting several accounts from different providers into one client is a fair question for an email product like Gmail, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows the reverse direction: Gmail mail can be added to other clients such as Outlook or Thunderbird over IMAP/POP/SMTP. Nothing shows Gmail itself connecting Microsoft 365 or IMAP accounts and working them in one place; delegation and adding Gmail to third-party clients are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can connect several accounts across providers — Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP — and work them from one place
